recognize_zh: GATA3染色中大多數腫瘤細胞核呈中等至強度不一的核陽性，少數細胞（多為基質或反應性細胞）為陰性；GATA3核陽性常見於ALK陰性ALCL（非DUSP22重排型），可作為輔助標記。
features: Nuclear GATA3 staining in the majority of cells with variable intensity
Positive nuclei are intermediate-to-large and round to oval
Interspersed negative nuclei, including spindle-shaped stromal cells
describe_en: GATA3 immunostain shows nuclear staining of variable intensity in the majority of the intermediate-to-large tumor cells, with interspersed negative stromal and reactive cells. The diffuse nuclear expression supports a GATA3-positive phenotype, which is common in ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma lacking DUSP22 rearrangement and in the PTCL-GATA3 subgroup. Correlation with CD30, ALK and genetic studies is required.

ddx.vs: PTCL-GATA3 lacks the uniform strong CD30 and hallmark cells that define ALCL.
DUSP22-rearranged cases are characteristically GATA3-negative and cytotoxic-marker negative with LEF1 expression, and are identified by FISH.
These are GATA3-positive but keratin-positive and CD30/T-cell-marker negative with cohesive epithelial nests.
